newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: IFC TO SIGN $250MLN CREDIT PACKAGE NOVA HUT ON FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: IFC TO SIGN $250MLN CREDIT PACKAGE NOVA HUT ON FRIDAY.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) said it would sign a $250 million credit pakcage on Friday with Czech steel maker Nova Hut a.s. .

An IFC statement said the credit was divided into a $75 million, 12-year senior loan on the IFC's own account, and a $175 million, 10-year senior syndicated B loan with 17 international institutions in the syndicate.

"The IFC financing, the largest ever arranged by the IFC in the Czech republic, will enable Nova Hut to embark n0o a comprehensiuve modernisation and environmental upgrade of its steel complex in Ostrava,"

The total $650 million prooject is to completed by the year 2000, and will allow Nova hut to compete internationally as one of the low-cost steel producers of flat rather than long steel products which it traditionally had produced, the statement said.
The largest participant in the syndicate was Deutsche Bank, and the IFC said eight Japanese banks provided some 40 percent of the syndicated loan financing, the IFC statement said.
The syndicate also includes banks from Austria, South Korea, the U.S., and Belgium.
Part of the money from the package is to be used for a hot-rolled coil mill, the construction of which is being managed by U.S.-based ICF Kaiser International.
